agents.about: Welcome to The NexGen Network – your trusted partner for finding your perfect home in breathtaking Colorado! With over 2000 families served and more than 1000 glowing 5-star Google reviews, our team of licensed real estate professionals is committed to delivering exceptional service.

agents.name: Kim Dozier
agents.about: Our philosophy is simple: It's all about YOU! I fell in love with Colorado in 2001. What started as a six-month stay turned into a lifelong commitment to the vibrant communities of downtown Denver and the mountains of Vail. With an entrepreneurial background, a successful fashion business and a degree in interior design the transition to real estate became a natural step for me.
